prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: single 74x100 dialogue head portrait for Kaem (凯姆, MAE-NPC-KAEM).
Input image roles: Image 1 is the historical same-person identity only: retain the angular side-parted hair silhouette, long slightly irregular nose, thick dark brows, short stubble and charcoal/ivory/brown librarian color family. DO NOT preserve its youthful face or all-brown hair: these are explicitly superseded by the current character card. Images 2-5 are approved pixel style and tight framing references (Mara, Ivo, Leiya, Tor), NOT this man's identity or exact expression.
Primary request: Redraw this SAME male deputy archivist in his MID-FORTIES, with PREMATURELY GRAY SALT-AND-PEPPER HAIR plainly dominant at temples and front part, a slightly stooped neck and raised uneven shoulders subtly implied only by bottom edge. Not a new man or an elderly grandfather. Face is lean and angular with pronounced mature cheekbone planes, slightly hollow under-eye planes, substantial longer nose, firm uneven jaw; not a young smooth black-haired handsome man. Dark low-set eyes, compact neutral mouth, very short sparse salt-and-pepper stubble as connected shadow planes along jaw/upper lip, NOT a full beard.
Expression: guarded intellectual self-importance and an unwillingly constrained explanation. One thick eyebrow sits slightly higher toward its outer end while the other is level and low; eyes sidelong toward viewer-left, lids slightly narrowed; lips compressed asymmetrically as if withholding his next qualification. Restrained defensiveness and pride, no worried or sorrowful inverted-V brows, no cartoon villain sneer, no big smile. Same distinctive nose and brow as old reference.
Hair: irregular side-parted cut swept back, visibly early-graying across broad ash-gray / warm-gray temple and top planes mixed with deep brown base. Four or five broad coarse masses. Salt-and-pepper should be formed by connected blocks, not speckles or single strands. Warm muted ochre skin, restrained dark-brown contour, cool ash hair contrasting face.
Costume visible only as a tiny bottom collar edge: ordinary charcoal gray librarian robe, modest ivory linen neckline, a brown worn inner layer. No modern suit lapels, ceremonial insignia, restored official seal, medals, spectacles, magic markings, weapon, book or scroll. Old seal box and borrowing ledger are below crop, not props. No claims of innocence or new authority.
Medium: serious grounded medieval RPG low-resolution hard-edged pixel portrait. Design expressly on a 74x100 logical grid. If larger output is unavoidable, it must look like uniform nearest-neighbor enlargement of those coarse pixels, not detailed art prepared for later shrinking. Large connected flat color clusters, sharp stepped contours. Strong warm near-black silhouette; constructed broad nose bridge, cheekbone and jaw planes. At most 32 visible palette colors. Matte skin and cloth. No gradients, soft antialiasing, dithering, stipple noise, glossy eyes or single-hair detail.
Framing: EXTREMELY TIGHT head-only dialogue portrait, as tightly filled as images 2-5. Crown 1-2 logical pixels from top; face/head silhouette occupies 90-97 percent of height and almost all width. Chin at about row 90; collar only the bottom 5-8 rows. No bust, visible torso, long neck, generous margins, prop or hands. Small deep-set human eyes with only muted tiny sclera slivers, not the enlarged eyes of image 1. Broad uninterrupted facial clusters and anatomical planes.
Background: genuine transparent alpha outside the silhouette. Single person, single portrait, no panels, label, letters, symbols, text, frame, UI or backdrop.
